svg.title: The Paddock family
svg.desc: Seven local-first desktop apps. Pacenotes, Debrief and Sighter above, Spotter, Dyno and Pitcrew below, Pitwall the optional local AI hub between them. Hand-offs: Pacenotes and Debrief exchange stack traces and log checks, Pacenotes sends Sighter test plans and gets results, Sighter sends Debrief run bundles, Pitcrew sends job logs, Dyno sends issues, installed software and machine health, Pitcrew runs CI for all, and Spotter will feed Sighter smoke tests later.
svg.text: Seven local-first tools for people who keep systems running
One private AI hub, one shared foundation. Each app is good alone and better together.

g.text: The shared foundation under every app.
Hand-off, arrow shows the direction of data
